choices.why: A clean Nordic three-seat sofa in light fabric with birch legs that matches the light wood the user asked for.
A comfortable wingback for reading, with light wooden legs, that brings the touch of green the user asked for.
A light wood coffee table with a simple Scandinavian design, in a compact size between the sofa and the armchair.
A large 200x300 flatweave in a soft grey-beige that fits under the whole seating area along this long room.
A 140 cm light wood table that seats six with two chairs per side and one at each end, and matches the coffee table.
Light wood armchairs with a natural paper-cord seat, warm and Nordic, that go with the table's wood.
A woven bamboo pendant that adds natural warmth and texture over the dining table.
Its swing arm aims the light right at the reading chair.
A low sideboard with simple Scandinavian lines whose warm wood ties in with the floor.
Light white linen that softens the big window without blocking the light.
Green cushions on the light sofa repeat the armchair's color and tie the living area together.
A cream cable-knit throw, exactly the warm textile the user asked for.
A tall, airy areca palm that fills the corner between the two zones and adds green.
A pair of minimalist black-and-white prints that fill the wall above the long sofa in a Nordic style.
A white textured stoneware vase with enough height to stand out on the sideboard.

answer.why: Light woods, light fabrics and cream knits keep the long room bright and Nordic, while the bamboo, the paper cord and the walnut sideboard add warmth over the oak floor. The green armchair, cushions and palm bring in the green the user asked for.
